title: Correct final answer
description: Essential: Student must state v = 2.5 m/s (or equivalent fraction).

title: Average speed definition
description: Essential: Student correctly uses average speed = total distance / total time.

title: Time expressions
description: Important: Student correctly writes time for first segment as (2s/3)/v and second as (s/3)/5.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Important: Student successfully solves the equation 3 = s / [(2s/3v) + (s/15)] for v.

title: Distance cancellation
description: Optional: Student recognizes total distance cancels in the average speed equation.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent units (m/s) throughout or explicitly notes them.

title: Incorrect average formula
description: Pitfall: Student uses arithmetic mean (v+5)/2 or similar incorrect average speed formula.

title: Sign or fraction error
description: Pitfall: Student makes algebraic error in combining fractions or solving the equation.
